references.text: Another occurrence of the same formula 'The Lord spoke to Moses' that introduces new instructions in Numbers.
The Lord speaks to Moses with the same introductory formula, giving instructions about the Levites' service.
The Lord speaks to Moses about the special position of the Levites, which is the theme introduced in 1:48-49.
An early occurrence of the formula 'The Lord spoke to Moses' in Exodus, establishing this as a recurring pattern for divine revelation.
The Lord calls on Moses and speaks to him, a parallel introductory formula used throughout Leviticus.
